title.zh: Anthropic把Skills也捐给Linux基金会，继MCP后再交出一套Agent标准
title.en: Anthropic把Skills也捐给Linux基金会，继MCP后再交出一套Agent标准

current_state.zh: Anthropic donated its Agent Skills format — the SKILL.md-based 'work manual' standard already used by ChatGPT, Cursor and GitHub Copilot among 70+ platforms — to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, transferring the name, logo, GitHub organization and domain to joint multi-company maintenance alongside MCP, while proposing versioning, a formal proposal process and security guidance amid reports of malicious skills in the ecosystem.
current_state.en: Anthropic donated its Agent Skills format — the SKILL.md-based 'work manual' standard already used by ChatGPT, Cursor and GitHub Copilot among 70+ platforms — to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, transferring the name, logo, GitHub organization and domain to joint multi-company maintenance alongside MCP, while proposing versioning, a formal proposal process and security guidance amid reports of malicious skills in the ecosystem.
